evidenceNotes: All eight packaged screenshots are current PHASE-3-002 captures; historical screenshots generated by retained regression tests are not packaged as new evidence.

Desktop/mobile/engine/speed/debug screenshots use an arranged six-hazard fixture at maximum speed, advanced through actual movement/collision simulation, then held for capture. Natural spawning can add hazards. Engine evidence is a crop of the same actual canvas; the camera is unchanged.
Impact evidence injects a colliding hazard into that fixture and advances the actual damage path; hitSerial, hull loss, burst and shield feedback are real.
Production is a real unmodified route-42 run after warmup, requested with ?debug=colliders; debugger DOM, inspection seam and unique geometry marker remain absent.

Performance diagnostics use a separate held six-hazard rendering fixture on the same Chrome/GPU/viewports before and after, with 60 warmup and 180 measured RAF frames. CPU submission and RAF intervals are not GPU timings or phone measurements.
Five VFX and collider restarts check resource identity/counts and six model downloads. Pause and focus checks freeze effect buffers; teardown verifies private resources are disposed once.
The missing-model test intentionally creates an HTTP 404 and verifies retry recovery. Other browser tests require clean console/network logs.
limitations: Physical phones, Safari/Firefox, sustained thermal/heap behavior and GPU timer queries remain unverified.
Collision proxies approximate surfaces; rounded-box/sphere intersections can retain small conservative errors near seams, with bounded rotation padding below 0.007 world units at 120 Hz.
The approved forgiving ship sphere excludes decorative wings. Decorative shield shimmer is not a gameplay collider. Audio and Yandex SDK are outside PHASE-3-002.
The existing Vite chunk-size advisory remains unchanged; no build-system refactor or threshold adjustment.
